film: The Dragon of the East Window
line: Sunlight crosses a cathedral window from dawn to dusk, waking each pane of a knight-and-dragon tale.
line_cn: 阳光从清晨移到黄昏，照到哪一格花窗，哪一格的故事就动起来。

a line being read; a character's decision; a detail

camera.expresses: The rule, or the whole story at once

transitions: Transitions: moving light, shafts, a crack, darkness;
never a dissolve, wipe or flip.
labels: Subtitles: a parchment banderole near the bottom (curled ends, gentle sag, thin rule), IM Fell English ~44 px in dark ink. It unfurls from the centre; text fades in only once it is ≥ 75 % open; pad the ribbon well past the text. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).

Titles: incised Roman capitals (Cinzel 600) in the stone, dark cut, light lower lip, gilding, revealed by a moving band of light; small lines ≥ 30 px on screen. In the glass, text only as grisaille on a white-glass scroll.
motion: Figures step at 8 fps; light, camera, shafts and dust move on ones (24 fps): stepped light reads as flicker.
Rigid pieces on 2D FK (setTransform(base · T(part)), free draw order); long bodies are spine chains of banded pieces.
Freeze rule: a pane's figures use min(t, tlightLeft). Actions land on the beat.
Crack: jagged lines race from the impact in ~¼ s, bright with light, a short white flash and a 2-frame shake.

native_moves.name: Light is time, and the camera
native_moves.does: Only the lit pane is alive; figures freeze when the light leaves.
native_moves.fits: the steps of a recipe; a factory's shifts; four seasons of one farm.

native_moves.name: Glass projects onto stone
native_moves.does: A key scene plays in the floor patch, which stretches as the sun sinks.
native_moves.fits: a memory seen larger than life; a sports play replayed as shadows; a data trend drawn by lengthening light.

native_moves.name: Glass cracks, lead mends
native_moves.does: Pieces slide along the leads into a new picture, leaving scars.
native_moves.fits: a company's reinvention; an injury and recovery; an old building restored.

native_moves.name: A window holds its own light
native_moves.does: At night one pane glows from a source inside the story.
native_moves.fits: a lighthouse keeper; a night-shift nurse; a server that never sleeps.

native_moves.name: The window as a diagram
native_moves.does: Lancets as columns, a rose as a wheel or dial, the border as a timeline.
native_moves.fits: a product lineup; the parts of a cycle; a family tree.

score.note: organ drones, harp, chimes, recorder; church modes, no piano or strings
